description: This file defines the ApiVersion class used for managing API versioning within the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It includes version constants, parsing logic, comparison methods, and feature support checks.

classes.name: ApiVersion
classes.description: Represents an API version with major and minor components, providing comparison, parsing, and feature support methods.

methods.name: ApiVersion
methods.description: Constructor initializing ApiVersion with original version string, major, and minor numbers.

methods.name: ApiVersion
methods.description: Constructor initializing ApiVersion with major and minor numbers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ApiVersion instance from a version string.

methods.name: extractNumber
methods.description: Extracts numeric value from a string using regex pattern.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this ApiVersion with another based on major version.

methods.name: supportsFileSuffixChange
methods.description: Checks if the API version supports changing file suffixes (supported from version 1.3).

methods.name: supportsNotesPathChange
methods.description: Checks if the API version supports changing notes path (supported from version 1.2).

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on major and minor version.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on major and minor version.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the ApiVersion object.
